_comment: Paths (relative to focusanalyze-fe root) temporarily moved out of app/ before the Tauri production build (scripts/build-fe.js) and restored after. These are marketing-site / web-only routes that either (a) aren't reachable from the authenticated dashboard the desktop app shows, or (b) use dynamic server APIs incompatible with `next build --output export`. Keep this in sync with focusanalyze-fe's app/ structure — see focusanalyze-desktop/README.md#tauri-production-build-scope for the full rationale.
